## Summary

Describe the focused change and the deployment truth it affects.

## Evidence and safety

- [ ] Provider access remains read-only.
- [ ] Missing evidence remains UNKNOWN/WARN rather than fabricated certainty.
- [ ] No credentials, customer data, absolute machine paths, or raw provider payloads are included.
- [ ] Truth-rule changes include deterministic tests.
